dangerous.name: Lithium toxicity
dangerous.recognize: Tremor, ataxia, and confusion — often when something changed (dehydration, renal function, an interacting drug).
dangerous.firstMove: Tell the senior now; hold the next dose and send a stat level with a BMP. Severe toxicity is a nephrology conversation (extracorporeal removal).

dangerous.name: Teratogenicity
dangerous.recognize: Ebstein anomaly risk with first-trimester exposure.
dangerous.firstMove: β-hCG before starting; peripartum decisions are made collaboratively, not by default discontinuation.

populations.pregnancy: Teratogen (Ebstein anomaly): β-hCG before starting. Weigh treated illness against exposure with maternal-fetal medicine and pharmacy rather than defaulting to discontinuation.
populations.geriatric: Older adults usually run lower target levels — check the attested Monitoring & Labs table.
populations.renal: Renally eliminated: renal function gates both starting and continuing.

t1: Lithium level is a 12-hour trough, drawn ~5 days after any dose change.
Tremor, ataxia, and confusion on lithium means think toxicity — especially after a change in hydration, kidney function, or medications.
t2: NSAIDs, ACE inhibitors/ARBs, and thiazides raise levels toward toxicity.

Anti-suicidal effect: meta-analytic support (Cipriani 2013), but the 2022 VA RCT adding lithium to usual care found no reduction in suicide-related events (Katz 2022). Know both before you quote either.

familyExplainer.text: Lithium can work very well, but the safe amount is a narrow window. That is why your family member needs regular blood tests. Help them drink enough fluids. Check with the team before they take pain pills like ibuprofen. Call if you see new shaking, stumbling, vomiting, or confusion.

t1: The clozapine ANC schedule (weekly → biweekly → monthly) is worth memorizing; myocarditis is the early killer beyond the count.
Low ANC, myocarditis, ileus, or a seizure on clozapine is a 'tell someone now' finding.
t2: Two adequate failed trials = treatment-resistant; raise clozapine rather than cycling further agents.
Smoking cessation raises clozapine levels (CYP1A2): the patient who quits at admission may need a dose decrease, not an increase.
The FDA eliminated the clozapine REMS in 2025; ANC monitoring continues per the prescribing information.

familyExplainer.text: Clozapine is often the best medicine when others have not worked. It needs regular blood tests, weekly at first. Call the team right away for fever, sore throat, chest pain, or constipation that lasts more than a day or two. Tell the team if your family member stops or starts smoking.
